flags.description:
This object is the primary method for customizing Lighthouse to a specific use case.
It overrides any settings present in the `config` field.
For instance to control the output format:
  - Use {output: 'json'} to generate a JSON report.
  - Use {output: 'html'} to generate an HTML report.
  - Use {output: 'csv'} to generate a CSV report.
A full list of flags can be found here https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/blob/master/types/externs.d.ts#L128-L139

config.description:
Configuration for the Lighthouse run.
If not provided, then Lighthouse default config will be used, see https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/blob/master/lighthouse-core/config/default-config.js#L104-L517
Further Config Documentation can be found here https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/blob/master/docs/configuration.md
